bodyNote: Dedicated FlightGear DHC8-300Q airframe shared by basic and approved higher-gross-weight Model 311 configurations; no geometric stretching. Length uses exact conversion of 84 ft 3 in. Tail target 7.40 m comes from basic 41,300 lb taxi-weight minimum clearance column; HGW use is illustrative. Nose overhang 2.44 m and attachment heights are source-mesh alignment assumptions calibrated to retained source surfaces. Ground heights depend on loading and configuration; source geometry does not derive pavement wheel centers. Nose struts meet retained bay-roof/upper-body surfaces where gear exclusion leaves an open belly cutout. Attachment heights are illustrative and do not measure manufacturer strut lengths.
